orders.instruction: Untested keyboard game: probe each key from comparable states and learn which objects move and which changes persist. Train an observation-conditioned policy toward discovered progress signals; add visited-state avoidance and recover from repeated cycles. Validate completed levels against all controls.

Untested click game: segment visible components and probe their centers, learning which clicks change selection, position, or board state. Learn state-dependent action sequences from those effects; avoid unchanged clicks and repeated boards. Validate completed levels against all controls.

Untested mixed-input game: probe keys and component-center clicks separately, then test whether selection changes key effects. Learn the interaction rules online and train short goal-directed sequences with cycle avoidance. Prioritize a reproducible first-level completion that beats all controls.

summary: Fill all 3 slots with untried games across keyboard, click, and mixed inputs. Require learned action effects and control-beating completions; stop launching work at 85% budget.
